notes.title: Christmas —New Yea Events
notes.content:
[h1]Christmas Events[/h1]
[h3]Christmas Treasure-Hunting[/h3]
Event time: Dec 25th 00:00 - Dec 31st 23:59

During the event, when you defeat any enemy and trade (single profit > 10,000 gold), you have a chance to obtain Christmas Red Hat (Max 50 pcs per day) and Christmas Candy Cane(Max 25 pcs per day), which can be exchanged for various items and gifts here. 

[h3]Cumulative Rewards[/h3]
Event time: Dec 25th 00:00 - Dec 31st 23:59

During the event, when your cumulative top-up amount reaches a given level, you could gain limited ship "Navia Christmas" and the limited re-run mount "Christmas Sledge". 

[h3]Recharge Rebate[/h3]
Event time: Dec 25th 00:00 - Dec 31st 23:59

Christmas special reward! During the event, when your cumulative top-up amount reaches a certain level, you can receive lots of extra diamonds as rewards!

[h3]Cash Rebate[/h3]
Event time: Dec 25th 00:00 - Dec 31st 23:59

During the event, accumulate a certain amount of diamond consumption (including blue diamonds and color diamonds) to claim multiple items.


[h1]New Year Events[/h1]
[h3]New Year Rewards[/h3]
Event time: Jan 1st 00:00 - Jan 7th 23:59

During the event, Compeleting everyday event quests to win rewards, and cumulate your event score to win progression rewards.

[h3]Cumulative Rewards[/h3]
Event time: Jan 1st 00:00 - Jan 7th 23:59

During the event, when your cumulative top-up amount reaches a given level, you could gain multiple rare items.

[h3]Cash Rebate[/h3]
Event time: Jan 1st 00:00 - Jan 7th 23:59

During the event, accumulate a certain amount of diamond consumption (including blue diamonds and color diamonds) to claim multiple rewards.
